routeCharacter: Easy coastal stage with mixed beach, rock, cycle path, local road, harbour approach, coastal forest and beach heath.
Starts at Steninge beach and heads south along the shore.
Climbs or passes onto cliffs at Blombergs with traces of historic stone quarrying and coastal views.
Follows cycle path toward Särdals Kvarn, then road toward Skallkroken harbour.
Passes through coastal forest around Skallen; official page suggests a viewpoint side trip up Skallen.
Final stretch follows beach heathlands into Haverdal/Båtabacken.

hazards.description: Official route climbs/passes Blombergs cliffs and field reports note rocky parts in the Steninge area. Wet rock and wind exposure can increase slip risk despite easy grade.
Beach/heath/dune sections can be affected by wind, loose sand, storm/high-water effects and seasonal wetness.
Haverdal reserve warns of strong currents and sudden seabed changes in windy weather, and soft/quicksand-like sand near the shifting Skintan outlet.
Official route uses cycle path toward Särdals Kvarn and local road toward Skallkroken harbour. Treat as standard traffic/shared-use awareness.
